 Why Exosome Serums Are the Latest Skin Care Obsession 
 Why Exosome Serums Are the Latest Skin Care Obsession 
 Innovative formulas that reduce fine lines and boost radiance.
 By Emma Aerin Becker Published: Oct 21, 2026 Save Article Share Article I’ve tested enough buzzy skin care to know that not every trending ingredient deserves a permanent spot on my bathroom shelf. Exosomes, however, have held my attention. These mini messengers work behind the scenes to support communication between cells, making them an intriguing addition to the growing world of anti-aging skin care. Now, they’re popping up in face serums designed to address the most stubborn signs of aging.
 “Exosomes are microscopic extracellular vesicles that essentially act as messengers between cells,” explains Melissa Fox , celebrity master esthetician and founder of Flawless by Melissa Fox. They carry signaling molecules such as proteins, lipids, and genetic material that help cells communicate. “I always explain them as little messengers telling the skin, ‘here’s what we need to do to repair and function better,’” she says. These signals support the skin’s natural processes to help reduce pigmentation, redness, and texture.
 What makes the ingredient particularly interesting is its gentler approach to skin care. Fox describes exosomes as part of her philosophy of “progressive, never aggressive skin care.” Rather than constantly stripping or irritating the complexion in pursuit of results, the goal is to support the skin barrier while encouraging a healthier-looking appearance.
 Of course, exosome technology is still an emerging category, and Fox notes that the science and quality can vary significantly between products—that makes choosing the right formula all the more important. To help, I sifted through the latest exosome face serums to find the formulas worth adding to your routine. Ahead, discover the best options for smoother, plumper, more radiant-looking skin.

 Medicube products have become synonymous with a glass-like finish, and the Exosome Shot 7500 is no different. The formula features micro-sized, needle-shaped spicules coated in exosomes that penetrate deep into the skin to deliver active ingredients effectively.
 Key ingredients: Exosome-coated spicules, AHA, BHA, PHA, niacinamide, panthenol
 Customer review: “Even though there are spicules, it surprisingly just causes a mild tingling sensation. A little goes a long way, and I have even been using it on my neck. I can tell that the fine lines are already getting less noticeable! This is very lightweight and makes my skin feel very firm even days after use. My skin is noticeably more even. It feels like my other skin care regimen is able to penetrate deeper into the skin as I feel so much cleaner. Highly recommend!” 
 How often should you use exosomes face serums?
 “Consistency is key,” says Fox. “Exosomes aren’t something I look at as an occasional ‘special treatment.’ If you’re investing in this type of technology, I want you using it consistently enough to give the skin time to respond.” That being said, once or twice daily is the typical recommendation depending on skin type and regimen.
 At which point in your skin care routine should you use exosome face serums?
 Exosome face serums should be applied immediately after cleansing to dry skin. “Use one pump and allow it to sit for about five minutes before applying anything else,” says Fox. Then you can continue with the rest of your routine, including hydrating serums, moisturizer, SPF, etc. “I don’t want five layers between an expensive exosomes serum and the skin,” Fox continues. “Give the technology first access to clean skin, let it absorb, and then layer everything else.”
